content.short: WeFi is a decentralized deobank offering self-custodial financial services and payments.
content.description: WeFi is a comprehensive 'deobank' (decentralized bank) designed to provide a full suite of financial services on-chain. It bridges the gap between traditional banking and DeFi by offering self-custodial wallets, crypto-collateralized payment cards, and efficient global remittance solutions. Built on a secure and transparent blockchain framework, WeFi empowers users to manage their digital assets with the same ease as traditional currency while maintaining full control over their private keys. The platform aims to make decentralized banking accessible and secure for a global audience.
